description: This file defines the EntityConstraintViolationList class, which extends ConstraintViolationList to manage and organize validation violations for Drupal entities, including grouping violations by entity fields and handling entity-level violations.

classes.name: EntityConstraintViolationList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of validation violations for a Drupal entity, providing methods to group violations by field or entity level, and to filter violations based on various criteria.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the violation list with a validated entity and an optional set of violations.

methods.name: groupViolationOffsets
methods.description: Groups violations by field and entity level, caching the offsets for efficient retrieval.

methods.name: getEntityViolations
methods.description: Returns violations that are at the entity level, not tied to specific fields.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves violations associated with a specific field.

methods.name: getByFields
methods.description: Retrieves violations associated with multiple specified fields.

methods.name: filterByFields
methods.description: Filters violations to only include those for specified fields, handling composite constraints.

methods.name: filterByFieldAccess
methods.description: Filters violations based on field access permissions for a given user account.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names that have violations.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity associated with the violation list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a violation to the list and resets cached groupings.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a violation at a specified offset and resets cached groupings.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces a violation at a specified offset and resets cached groupings.
